inspected_anchors.finding: Identity, proceedings and date; dataset link is a lead only.
Four perspectives per scenario,100 CLadder seed cases; text/code/math expansion.
Manual seeds and GPT-4 Turbo generation; no original dataset bytes inspected.
Claimed extraction/inference engine and disagreement-triggered manual review.
Estimator outline and IV/front-door mentions; these require their own identification assumptions.
Agreement accepted as ground truth; four-question joint versus marginal score definitions.
Tables1-3; GPT-4 Turbo math61.4% joint and88.7% overall; cross-domain rankings differ.
Hallucination comparison is a separate leaderboard association; stated limitations.
CLADDER bibliography attribution differs from the inspected Jin et al. original; requires version/identity reconciliation.

supported_claims: The paper reports a four-perspective group metric across text, math and code; it uses GPT-4 Turbo generation and targeted human review of disagreements.
Joint correctness is a stricter descriptive outcome but neither eliminates guessing nor proves causal understanding.
Reported math GPT-4 Turbo61.4% joint versus88.7% overall is source evidence, not locally replicated performance.
Claimed engine availability, exact dataset/version/count, rights and every causal label remain unverified.

inspected_anchors.finding: Named-variable graph reconstruction;163 candidate BNs and source/size selection.
35 graphs,14 repository/21 paper; GPT-4o metadata extraction; provenance/size selection.
Pair/triplet limited to10 nodes,efficient50; others broader; leave-one-graph fine-tuning.
SHD convention reversal costs2; edge normalization; Table2 scoped comparisons; source-recall contamination probe.
Table3 false positives and Table4 node recall; graph-size-specific evidence.
Less-than15% count deviation and recall>0.85 rule; named asiam contamination flag includes Llama3.3 output9 versus7.
Manual JSON intervention; token limits; no underlying-data/classical discovery comparison; paraphrase caveat.
Source-conditioned node/edge prompts and model-based semantic matching.
Table9 Llama3.3 asiam9 generated/7 true,recall1; matching prompt; low recall not evidence of no training exposure.

supported_claims: 35 chosen BN graphs support a named-variable graph reconstruction comparison, not tabular causal identification.
Method size limits and graph provenance differ; exact source metric counts a reversed edge twice.
GPT-4o Table2 small-graph normalized SHD baseline0.65,pair1.67,triplet2.02; these are scoped source-reported outcomes.
The recall/count probe is a diagnostic, without established sensitivity or specificity for training exposure.
Reported Llama3.3 asiam contamination designation conflicts with the stated15% count threshold on the printed9/7 counts.
